title: NFL's new 'Rivalries' uniforms are here for NFC North and AFC South: Eight teams just got a new look for 2026

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL's new 'Rivalries' uniforms are here for NFC North and AFC South: Eight teams just got a new look for 2026
sources.description: All eight NFC North and AFC South teams unveiled city-themed alternate designs and new helmets, which each club will wear once during the 2026 season
